current_source_or_method: issuer monthly operating releases; FY/H1 bridge
research_caveat: Forecast ASK is directly carried from company traffic assumptions; route-level future capacity remains incomplete.

current_source_or_method: issuer monthly operating releases; FY/H1 bridge
research_caveat: Forecast RPK is modelled from issuer anchor/scenario assumptions.

current_source_or_method: RPK / ASK
research_caveat: Derived weighted load factor; route/cabin mix is not separately modelled.

current_source_or_method: passenger RASK proxy x ASK
research_caveat: Issuer passenger revenue anchors are available for covered FY/H1 periods; forward passenger revenue remains a RASK proxy.

current_source_or_method: issuer disclosed yield where available; otherwise total revenue / ASK proxy
research_caveat: Not a clean route/cabin realized yield series across all names.

current_source_or_method: forecast revenue less aggregate operating-cost bridge
research_caveat: Where FY2025 reported operating profit is available it is used as the historical residual anchor; forward cost mix is still aggregated.

current_source_or_method: MOFCOM monthly exports/imports; issuer cargo tonnes where available
research_caveat: External trade proxy is broad and not airline-specific.

current_source_or_method: State Post Bureau cumulative revenue/parcel volume and segment split
research_caveat: Broad e-commerce/logistics context only; it is not airline cargo demand and does not directly change the revenue forecast.

current_source_or_method: MOT Spring Festival transport and MCT holiday tourism/spend events
research_caveat: Low-frequency event control; duration-normalized but not converted into monthly company RPK.

current_source_or_method: issuer monthly airport production bulletins (Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangzhou)
research_caveat: Airport throughput includes many carriers and is hub context only; it is not company RPK or revenue.

current_source_or_method: Reported FY2025 cargo revenue grown by external trade proxy where anchors reconcile
research_caveat: Cargo demand is not airline-specific and cargo yield remains incomplete; fallback residual is retained where the annual split is unavailable.

current_source_or_method: issuer cargo/RTK/yield disclosures where available
research_caveat: No uniform airline-by-airline forward tonnage and yield model.

current_source_or_method: airport cargo throughput versus company cargo tonnage/revenue
research_caveat: Hub mapping is directional; airport throughput includes many carriers and is calibration context only.

current_source_or_method: reported cargo revenue per tonne applied to H1-2026 issuer tonnage
research_caveat: Yield is not uniform by route/commodity; tonnage is preliminary monthly data and the Spring/Juneyao anchor is FY-annualized.

current_source_or_method: FY2025 total/passenger/cargo residual grown with forecast passenger-revenue growth
research_caveat: No separate ancillary attach-rate/ARPU model; this is a transparent residual proxy rather than a disclosed forward segment forecast.

current_source_or_method: EIA daily/weekly benchmark
research_caveat: Benchmark is not company realized purchase price.

current_source_or_method: fuel cost per ASK / aggregate CASK
research_caveat: Volume is not independently forecast from block hours and aircraft type.

current_source_or_method: issuer hedging disclosure coverage
research_caveat: Disclosure/status exists, but hedge book cash-flow accounting is not fully integrated.

current_source_or_method: official surcharge schedules plus dated surcharge-to-fuel recovery proxy
research_caveat: Regulated per-passenger surcharges are not realized fuel-cost recovery; the recovery ratio is context only.

current_source_or_method: aggregate operating-cost / ASK bridge
research_caveat: Maintenance, labor, airport and distribution costs are not fully decomposed.

current_source_or_method: issuer/Cathay fleet disclosures plus Wikipedia fleet-composition snapshot (in-service/on-order by type)
research_caveat: Composition and order book are dated secondary-aggregator context; a forward delivery/retirement schedule is still incomplete for every name and the snapshot never overrides an official fleet total.

current_source_or_method: issuer disclosed daily utilization where available plus CAAC sector utilization
research_caveat: Not independently forecast by fleet type/route.

current_source_or_method: 12306/Ctrip route observations
research_caveat: Route-specific demand elasticity and revenue impact are not integrated.

current_source_or_method: forecast operating contribution + FY2025 reported below-operating residual
research_caveat: Residual combines finance cost, FX, tax, associates and NCI; it is more transparent than a net-to-operating ratio but is not a granular forecast.

current_source_or_method: residual net-income proxy / FY2025 official basic-EPS implied share count
research_caveat: This is not diluted EPS and does not model future issuance/buybacks; the below-operating residual is carried forward.

current_source_or_method: reported FY2025 waterfall anchors plus residual forward bridge
research_caveat: The historical waterfall is now carried into v3; forward finance cost, FX, tax and associate income are still not separately forecast.

current_source_or_method: reconciled FY2025 waterfall; finance cost scaled with forecast revenue; other rows carried
research_caveat: Currently available only where the historical formal waterfall reconciles; it is a scenario diagnostic, not the primary EPS forecast.

current_source_or_method: FY2025 effective tax rate (curated anchors where needed) and latest ECB USD/CNY carry
research_caveat: Tax rate is historical and FX is a carry assumption, not a forward regime view; loss/reversal cases keep absolute tax.

current_source_or_method: FY2025 basic-EPS implied share count only
research_caveat: No forward issuance, buyback, option or minority-ownership forecast.

current_source_or_method: free public consensus discovery layers
research_caveat: Useful comparator but not complete broker-vintage consensus for every issuer.

current_source_or_method: free market/financial history and valuation bands
research_caveat: Historical multiples still inherit denominator and point-in-time coverage caveats.
